design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — workers_comp_referrals_and_billing, task 0 (Work Hardening extension called in by the adjuster).

[Step 0 — draw, printed by draw_counts.py --task 0] {"task": 0, "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [6, 4, 6]}. Assignment: wc_ext_program_day_hours = 6 factors, wc_ext_program_day_charge = 4 factors, wc_ext_program_extension_days = 6 factors (multiset [4,6,6] = draw). Task 1 draw (for headroom): prerequisite_problems 1, factor_counts [4,4].

[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing (first task). Claimed here: the hour-billed program cluster of the wc charter — recording an attended program day (wc_visit_billed units), billing it (wc_charge_posted program_hours amount) and the adjuster's in-person extension (wc_authorization_received + wc_auth_recorded) — with tools record_program_day_6fda50ae, post_program_day_charge_5325d445, record_program_extension_8df51c57. Left for task 1 (independent, load-bearing): the Functional Capacity Evaluation cluster — the adjuster's FCE authorization (user write, hours) and the missed-evaluation fee billed to the carrier (wc_charge_posted fce_no_show), a one-edge tree whose fee depends on the authorized hours; no tool or policy of this task is needed there.

[Thesis] Surface goal: the adjuster wants to authorize the next stretch of Rafael Underwood's Work Hardening program herself and asks how many program days at what weekly frequency. Scored core: visits = 3 (and the recorded frequency 3) of the extension. Hidden chain: the extension rule says it "is not recorded until the referral carries a program-hours charge for every program day the worker attended in the appointment series funded by the referral"; the series shows 2026-09-30 attended and the referral has no charge (and no recorded day) for it. The charge rule says it "is fixed only after the referral carries the recorded program day for that date of service, with its program hours". So the agent must (1) record today's day (7 hours, 6 factors), (2) bill it (508.00, 4 factors), (3) hand the extension to the adjuster (3 days, 6 factors). Depth: chain of 2 hops. Breadth: 16 factors over the referral's own ledger (evaluation charge date, suspension start, missed-visit reports, progress/FCE/work-status reports, authorization in force), the series ledger (no-shows, cancellations, series format) and tier parameters of the Work Hardening Program.

[Problem-tree card]
root wc_ext_program_extension_days (owner user, record_program_extension_8df51c57)
  edge 1: -> wc_ext_program_day_charge, kind state_gate, gate wc_events.charge_kind, form state, policy_source "An extension is not recorded until the referral carries a program-hours charge for every program day the worker attended in the appointment series funded by the referral." (negated direction: a booking/recording waits). condition: every attended series appointment has a program_hours charge with the same date. Seed falsity: series_events att 2026-09-30 (series_visit_attended) and the latest program_hours charge is 2026-09-25 (the 2026-09-28 appointment was cancelled by the clinic). Only one write of the difficulty creates a program-hours charge: post_program_day_charge_5325d445 (the FCE fee tool of task 1 posts charge_kind fce_no_show, never program_hours). Resolved by the agent.
  edge 2: wc_ext_program_day_charge -> wc_ext_program_day_hours, kind value_input, gate day_hours, form state, policy_source "A program day's charge is fixed only after the referral carries the recorded program day for that date of service, with its program hours." (affirmative: a charge is fixed only after what it rests on is complete). condition: a wc_visit_billed entry for the date billed with its hours. Seed falsity: latest recorded program day 2026-09-25 (5 hours), none for 2026-09-30. Only record_program_day_6fda50ae writes a recorded program day. Resolved by the agent.
Four-point test on both sentences: explicit ordering connective (not ... until / only after); the waited-on side is a record-visible state named in table/finder words (a program-hours charge, a recorded program day); no tool, id or snake_case token; strength matches condition (every attended day / that date of service). Derivation: sentence + series history (2026-09-30 attended, no entry) + the depended-on rules (the charge rule bills "Each recorded program day"; the hours rule records "Every program day a worker attends") -> exactly one action each.
Topological order: record day (step 7) -> bill day (step 9) -> extension (step 11); a chain, so no parallel-order ambiguity. Deletion sensitivity (run): skip step 7 -> charge recomputes 0.00 (no hours recorded for 2026-09-30) instead of 508.00 and authorized_visits_remaining stays 5; skip step 9 -> no 508.00 charge, receivable 2980.00 instead of 3488.00 (extension visits unchanged = state_gate). Value_input edges: 1 >= max(2-1,1).
No prerequisite in user_scenario: the adjuster never mentions attendance, hours, billing or records; she says she does not know whether he came in today. Tools validate nothing (see prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block).

[Base-invariant card]
- wc_visit_billed (step 7): wc_authorization.wc_billable_status — referral status active (initial_state wc_cases.status) -> holds. wc_authorization.adjuster_authorization_covers — authorization BRA5091877 (row auth2) covers 2026-09-08..2026-10-02, 5 days unused, 2026-09-30 inside -> holds; the 2026-09-30 day is drawn on BRA5091877 (correlation key wc_events.auth_reference -> arg auth_reference). wc_agg_claim_frequency (no structured gate): week of 2026-09-28 has no recorded day before today (the 09-28 appointment was cancelled by the clinic), authorized 4/week, program max 5 -> within.
- wc_charge_posted (step 9): wc_evt_charges.compensable_payer — compensability form_60_accepted -> billed to the carrier. Bill submitted the same day, inside the 75-day deadline. wc_employer_direct: not an employer direct referral -> scope only.
- wc_authorization_received / wc_auth_recorded (step 11): wc_authorization has no gate on these subjects (its gates apply to wc_visit_billed); the extension becomes the authorization in force (reference, end date, weekly frequency follow the newest authorization). No time gate is involved in any of the three writes (temporal_feasibility = []).

[Business-object card] Target object: the Work Hardening referral (one wc_cases row) and its 2026-09-30 date of service. Rows in aggregates: missed-visit reports 2026-09-09 (no_show) and 2026-09-14 (late_cancellation) — both inside the last month; progress reports sent on Tuesdays 2026-08-25/09-01/09-08/09-15/09-22 (latest 09-22); FCE re-test report 2026-09-03 (a Thursday); work status updates after every program day (latest 2026-09-25); latest recorded program day 2026-09-25 (re-conditioning gap); evaluation charge 2026-08-17 (program clock start); series no-show 2026-09-09 (the 2026-09-14 worker cancellation and the 2026-09-28 clinic cancellation are cancellations, not no-shows, and are excluded from the frequency count by the rule's own word "no-shows"; the clinic cancellation is not a missed program day and was not reported to the adjuster). Already settled: remittance BRMEFT5926601 (2026-09-25) paid the evaluation and the 08-19..08-28 days less 5% network discounts; open receivable 2980.00 is the 08-31..09-25 days. Reports are dated on non-program days and history hours are computed with the work status in force on each date (off work until the physician's 2026-09-16 modified-duty restrictions), so the seeded history reproduces under the rules without a same-day convention.

[Factor card — wc_ext_program_day_hours, result 7, baseline (every factor at fall-through) 8]
progression_clock (method; date): suspension start 2026-09-14 is 16 days back (<= 21) -> count from the suspension start = 16 (calendar would be 44); substituting the baseline gives 8. Near-miss: the 2026-09-09 no-show was followed by its own non-compliance suspension, but the referral keeps only the latest suspension start (2026-09-14), which is the only date the rule reads; the 2026-09-09 row is a missed-visit report, not a suspension start.
graded_phase (parameter; date/history/tier): count 16 -> midpoint of the program's 4 and 8 daily hours = 6 (Work Conditioning would give (2+4)//2 = 3, inside its band); baseline max -> 8.
retest_hours (parameter; history): latest progress report 8 days ago (one interval of 7, less than two) -> +1; baseline 0 -> 6. Near-miss: the 2026-09-25 work status update is not a progress report.
reconditioning_cut (parameter; history/date): latest recorded program day 2026-09-25, 5 days -> 1 hour; baseline 0 -> 8. Near-miss: the 2026-09-28 appointment exists in the series but was cancelled by the clinic and never recorded, so it does not shorten the gap.
[Factor card — wc_ext_program_day_charge, result 508.00, baseline 448.00]
retest_split (parameter): 1 billed re-test hour (report 8 days old) -> baseline 480.00. retest_rate (parameter): FCE re-test 27 days ago -> 96.00 -> baseline 476.00. conditioning_rate (parameter; cross-difficulty series): Extended 60-Minute Visit Series -> 68.00 -> baseline 492.00. day_length_pricing (method): 6 conditioning hours -> block 140.00 + 4 x 68.00 -> baseline 504.00.
[Factor card — wc_ext_program_extension_days, result 3, baseline 6]
requested_frequency (parameter; multi-source; cross-difficulty series): 1 series no-show + 2 reported missed days -> 3/week; baseline 5 -> 5. Near-miss: the 2026-09-14 and 2026-09-28 cancellations are not no-shows. request_window (parameter): 1 whole week left -> final block of 1 week (tiers 1 / 3 / 2 weeks: final block, compliant three-week block, standard); baseline 2 weeks -> 6. unused_day_netting (method): authorization ends in 2 days (lead 3) -> lesser of 4 and 2 = 2; baseline 4 -> 1. transition_days (parameter; multi-source): modified duty + update 5 days ago -> +2; baseline -> 1. discharge_retest_days (parameter; multi-source): window reaches the program end + FCE baseline on file -> +1; baseline -> 2. reentry_reduction (parameter): suspension 16 days ago -> -1; baseline -> 4.
No factor reads a stamp: tiers rest on dates and ledger rows; the only flag read (fce_baseline_on_file) is an entry document, not an outcome stamp. The expiring authorization's 4 per week and the series' 3 standing slots are not read by the frequency ladder (copying the authorization gives 4, not the requested 3). Multi-source factors: modified_duty_shortening, requested_frequency, transition_days, discharge_retest_days. Cross-difficulty: conditioning_rate, requested_frequency (series ledger/holding seeded for this customer).

[Overwrite] wc_ext_program_day_charge declares the override of wc_evt_charges "each later date of service is billed as unit_rate times the billing units, with units counted in billing_unit and capped at max_billable_units_per_day (and, for hour-billed programs, between program_hours_per_day_min and program_hours_per_day_max)." replaced by the program-day billing sentence; wc_ext_program_day_hours now cites wc_evt_charges in its lineage and declares the same clause replaced by its own sentence for the recorded hours (never above the daily maximum; a day that works out below the minimum is recorded at the hours delivered). The compensable_payer gate sentence is not quoted and stays in force; base params keep their values (unit_rate 64.00 remains the fall-through rate). The extension policy declares [].

[Seed rows and why they exist] customer (identity: DOB 1979-03-14, phone 8285550147 stated by the adjuster); wc_cases (status, authorization in force at 4 per week, unused 5, suspension start, work status, FCE flag, receivable 2980.00); 2 authorizations (8 days at 3/week, 11 days at 4/week); evaluation visit + charge (program clock); 14 recorded program days with hours computed by the hours rule at each date and 14 program-hours charges computed by the billing rule (so history never teaches another method); 6 payments + 6 network discounts (settled remittance, 5% each, paid inside 60 days so no penalty is owed); 5 progress reports, 1 initial evaluation report, 1 FCE re-test report, 14 work status updates (Work Hardening sends one after every program day); 2 missed-visit reports; appointment series (Extended 60-Minute, Mon/Wed/Fri, card on file, 1 booked visit left: 2026-10-02) with 2 bookings, 15 attendances, 1 no-show, 2 cancellations (2026-09-14 by the worker, 5 hours notice, transportation; 2026-09-28 by the clinic, 46 hours notice; workers' comp funding so no fee). Removing the 2026-09-30 attendance removes the whole prerequisite chain; removing the suspension start moves the progression clock and the re-entry reduction; removing the missed reports moves make-up and frequency; recording 2026-09-28 would remove the re-conditioning cut. Automatic clauses checked: no bill older than 60 days unpaid with a payment (no penalty owed), no suspension running, series not at its release threshold (2 worker misses < 3 in 60 days; clinic cancellations do not count), the progress report due 2026-09-29 is a reporting duty with no extended policy and no number; it is left as is.

[Base defects routed around, frozen blueprint untouched] (1) blueprint says no wc write is the worker's own; the user write here is the adjuster's own authorization (the caller is the adjuster, verified with the worker's credentials as for any third party acting on the file). (2) every series format allows at most 3 visits per week while Work Hardening allows 5: the program is scheduled Mon/Wed/Fri at 3 per week, inside both, under an authorization of up to 4 per week. (3) the series attendance triggers wc_visit_billed but the hours are the referral's to fix; the pending 2026-09-30 day is the billing desk's recording that the agent performs.

[Persona design] Denise Whitlock, brisk adjuster; volunteers only the goal, her own reference BRA5103346 and dates 2026-10-05..2026-10-12; gives DOB/phone/claim number only when asked; cannot give email/ZIP/account (cannot-answer branch); defers days and frequency to the clinic ("Whatever your program calls for"); passive consent if the agent says clinic-side work is needed first; records the extension exactly as handed; closes when told it is recorded. No ask outside gold.

[Standard solution] find_customers(name) -> verify (DOB, phone) -> find_wc_cases -> find_wc_events -> find_appointment_series -> find_series_events -> unlock+call record_program_day (2026-09-30, 7, BRA5091877) -> unlock+call post_program_day_charge (2026-09-30, 7, 508.00) -> unlock_user + adjuster calls record_program_extension (BRA5103346, 3, 3, 2026-10-05, 2026-10-12).

[Verification run] authoring scripts evaluated each computation with check_compute.build_env/eval_compute on the replayed handling-time world: hours 7 (baselines progression 8, phase 8, make-up 5, re-test 6, re-conditioning 8, modified 8; all 8); charge 508.0 (480.0, 476.0, 492.0, 504.0; all 448.0); extension 3 (frequency 5, window 6, netting 1, transition 1, discharge 2, re-entry 4; all 6). Skip step 7 -> charge 0.0; skip step 9 -> extension 3 (unchanged, state_gate). Gates (round 2, final block without --task): EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; REPLAY OK; SOLVABILITY OK; COMPUTE OK; GROUNDING OK; SCOPE OK.

[Revisions] (a) symptom: check_extended counted a helper function as an unnamed task tool -> root: module-level helper in task_tools.py -> change: inlined the referral lookup -> rerun OK. (b) symptom: replay dangling FK for empty care_plan_id/package_id/membership_id on the series row -> change: omitted the unused funding keys -> REPLAY OK. (c) symptom: check_compute "history NOT load-bearing" for the charge (LATEST is not zeroed) -> change: the charge reads the hours recorded for its date of service by SUM over the day's recorded program days, and the rule now states that a program day is billed on its date of service -> COMPUTE OK; edge sensitivity text updated (skip -> 0.00). (d) design: the extension first also depended directly on the recorded day; at the opening every recorded day already had a charge, so that gate was satisfied at frozen time — the tree was re-cut into the chain extension <- charge <- recorded day with the extension's gate stated over attended (series) days, which is false at the opening. Round 2 (policy-task audit): T0-F1 / F-G1 — the late_arrival ladder's 1-9-minute tier always equalled the fall-through and series grace (15 min) made a third outcome impossible -> factor removed (rule sentence, compute, factor, series cross read) and replaced by reconditioning_cut (calendar days since the latest recorded program day: 2 h / 1 h / none), with the world changed so the 2026-09-28 appointment is a clinic cancellation (gap 5 days -> 1 h); hours stay 7. T0-F2 / F-G2 — request_window's tiers collapsed and were constants -> relabelled parameter with three distinct values (final block 1 week / compliant 3-week block / standard 2 weeks); world tier unchanged (1 week). F-G3 — graded phase middle tier now the midpoint of the program's minimum and maximum daily hours (6 for Work Hardening, 3 for Work Conditioning). T0-F3 — false near-miss sentence replaced (see factor card). O-G4 — the hours policy now cites wc_evt_charges and declares the min/max clause replaced by its own sentence. O-T0-2 — the current authorization is now 4 per week, so copying it no longer yields the requested 3. O-T0-3 — progress and FCE reports moved to non-program days and the work-status history stated, so the seeded history reproduces without a same-day convention. Downstream: computations, factor_sensitivity, tracing, prerequisite_closure evidence (latest recorded day/charge now 2026-09-25), business effects (receivable 2980.00 -> 3488.00, unused 5 -> 4 -> 7) and seed_consistency regenerated.

[Manual value gates] Long and broad: 2 hops, 16 factors, 3 ledgers (referral, series, tier). User write: the extension is the adjuster's own authorization, recorded in person on the call. Need/simulator boundary: target (Rafael's Work Hardening referral), timing (today, before Friday's end date), mode (she records it herself; the clinic tells days/frequency). Chronology: every volunteered fact (claim, current end date 2026-10-02) is in initial_state. Time anchors: no time gate; DAYS counts calendar days between dates as stated. Authority: compensability, authorization, status from system rows only. No real-world wait: the day was already attended; recording, billing and the adjuster's authorization are synchronous. Every ladder now has three distinct outcomes on the programs it reaches (hours: no late-arrival tier remains; extension window 1 / 3 / 2 weeks). Draft recomputation from visible context (KB prose of the three rules + schemas + finder returns + persona) gives the same three writes and values: 7 / 508.00 / 3 at 3 per week.
user_scenario:
You are Denise Whitlock, a workers' compensation claims adjuster with Blue Ridge Mutual Insurance Company, calling Piedmont Motion's patient services line from your desk in Asheville about your claimant Rafael Underwood, who is in the Work Hardening Program at Piedmont Motion Asheville West on claim BRM5260417. You are brisk, organized and friendly, you work from your claim file, and you speak like someone who handles thirty files a week.

Your reason for calling is simple: Rafael's current work hardening authorization runs out this Friday, October 2, and you want to authorize the next stretch of his program today so he does not lose any days. You plan to put the extension in yourself, in person, on the clinic's adjuster line while you are on the phone, under your own authorization reference BRA5103346, covering Monday, October 5 through Monday, October 12 — you understand the 12th to be the last day his eight-week program can run. What you need from the clinic is how many program days to authorize and at what weekly frequency; you have no number in mind and you say so: "Whatever your program calls for — I just want it right the first time so my supervisor doesn't kick it back."

You open with the name and the request. Only when the agent asks you to confirm the claimant's identity do you read from the file: his date of birth is 1979-03-14 and the phone number on the claim is 8285550147. If asked for the claim number, it is BRM5260417. You do not know his email, ZIP code or patient account number and say so if asked. You do not know whether he came in today, how many hours he did, what has been billed or what is still unused on the current authorization — if the agent asks, tell them to go by their own records.

If the agent explains that something on the clinic's side has to be put on the referral before the extension can be worked out or recorded, you are fine with that and tell them to go ahead and do it while you hold; you do not ask for details. When the agent gives you the number of program days and the weekly frequency and hands you the extension to record, you record it yourself exactly as they give it, with your reference BRA5103346 and the dates October 5 through October 12, and the referral reference number they read out to you. If the agent instead suggests you do anything else first, you ask them to just tell you what the referral needs.

Once you hear that the extension is recorded on the referral, you thank the agent, say you will note the file, and end the call. You never suggest a number of days or a frequency yourself, never mention attendance, billing or reports on your own, and never ask for anything beyond the extension.

request_binding.action_semantics: An attended program day is owed a recorded program-day entry whatever the caller asks (state_due): the series shows 2026-09-30 attended and the referral has no program day for it; recording (not billing, not authorizing) is the action that creates that entry.

A visit or program day is recorded only while the referral is in referral_received or active status;

Where adjuster_authorization_required is true, a date of service after the first initial_visits_without_auth visits is recorded against an authorization only when an adjuster authorization in force covers that date and still has visits remaining;

request_binding.action_semantics: A recorded program day of an accepted claim is owed a carrier charge (state_due); the day recorded at step 7 is the only recorded day without a program-hours charge, so billing it is the action, not another recording or an adjustment.

stage_provenance.fact: The recorded program day and its 7 hours that the charge bills were established by the recording write at step 7, synchronously in this call.

The employer direct rules cover only Employer Direct Early Intervention referrals; this referral is a Work Hardening Program on a carrier claim, so the charge goes to the carrier and no direct-pay invoice or cap applies.

edges.policy_source: An extension is not recorded until the referral carries a program-hours charge for every program day the worker attended in the appointment series funded by the referral.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain (extension <- charge <- recorded day), so the only topological order is record day, bill day, record extension. No parallel prerequisites exist. Billing before recording finds no program hours recorded for 2026-09-30 (day_hours 0) and bills 0.00 instead of 508.00; recording the extension before the charge breaks the stated gate.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the charge write leaves the 2026-09-30 day unbilled: terminal wc_events lacks the 508.00 program_hours charge and wc_cases.receivable_balance stays 2980.00 instead of 3488.00 (the extension's own visits value 3 is unchanged: a state_gate edge).

Skipping the recording write: no program hours stand for 2026-09-30 (day_hours 0), the charge recomputes to 0.00 instead of 508.00, and wc_cases.authorized_visits_remaining stays 5 instead of 4 (the terminal extension remaining 8 instead of 7).
